fields.value: Identifying GNSS transmitters based on their RadioFrequency (RF) features - a dataset with GNSS roofantenna and Spectracom-based GNSS signals

dsDescriptionValue.value: This dataset contains GNSS signals collected via roof antennas and Spectracom simulator for the purpose of Radio-Frequency Fingerprinting studies for signal-type identification. We offer six different scenarios in open-access for further testing, although additional scenarios are available on-demand (could not be uploaded due to Zenodo maximum uploading limits). This dataset is realted to the paper "Identifying GNSS transmitters based on their RadioFrequency (RF) features - a dataset with GNSS roofantenna and Spectracom-based GNSS signals" (Doi).

publicationCitation.value: Identifying GNSS Signals Based on Their Radio Frequency (RF) Features—A Dataset with GNSS Raw Signals Based on Roof Antennas and Spectracom Generator
